card.$description: Card: a surface holding one thing: a picture, a header (avatar, title, subtitle, an action), content and a row of actions.

variant.$description: The look it takes when none is given: elevated, filled, outline.

footer-align.$description: Where the row of actions sits: start, end.

sm.$description: Space around the header, the content and the actions.
Space between the header, the content and the actions.

header-gap.$description: Space between the avatar, the titles and the action.

media-width.$description: The picture's width when it stands at the start (horizontal).

card.$description: The card, at rest, then `elevated`, `filled`, `outline`, `selected`, and `hover`, `pressed`, `focus` (clickable and link cards), `disabled`.
